newsitem.title: USA: Hayes files to register 3.7 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Hayes files to register 3.7 mln shares.

text.p: Hayes Wheels International Inc filed Monday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of up to 3,779,502 common shares, of which the company will sell two million common shares and the remaining 1,779,502 shares will be offered by a group of shareholders.
Of the shares to be offered, three million will be sold in the United States and Canada and 779,502 shares will be offered overseas.
Underwriters for the offering, Merrill Lynch & Co, Bear, Stears & Co Inc, Goldman Sachs & Co and Smith Barney Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 566,925 shares.
Hayes said it will use the proceeds from the shares it sells to repay outstanding bank debt.
After the offering, the company will have 29,541,220 shares outstanding.
